description: SIM97 — RIFT full Planck 2018 plikHM TTTEEE likelihood. Replaces the approximate Gaussian likelihood used in SIM89 with the official Planck 2018 plikHM TTTEEE likelihood (plik_rd12_HM_v22b_TTTEEE.clik) via clipy. Tests three cosmologies: RIFT BAO-only (SIM87), RIFT joint CMB+BAO (SIM90), and LCDM Planck best-fit. Also tests the TTTEEE_lite_native likelihood as a cross-check. This is the definitive CMB consistency test for RIFT against real Planck data.

rift_joint.note: RIFT joint CMB+BAO best-fit (SIM90). Should match Planck.

rift_bao_only.note: RIFT BAO-only best-fit (SIM87). Expected to show tension.

nuisance.note: Planck nuisance parameters fixed to best-fit values from Planck 2018 Table 1 (Aghanim+2020). A_planck=1 (calibration). Foreground parameters at Planck best-fit.

acceptance.note: PASS if |Delta(-2lnL)(RIFT_joint - LCDM)| < 5 on plikHM TTTEEE. This is the definitive test.
